scope.meaning: Focused learning read/persistence traversal; existing synthetic run/event integration retained. Not all 40 workflows newly exercised end to end.

findings.summary: Four learning reads swallowed corrupt local snapshots into HTTP 200 empty/zero projections; selected SQL schema/query failures could also return stale local data.
findings.fix: Fallible reads, generic HTTP 500, no-store success/storage errors, no silent fallback or DB-disable latch for a selected SQL read.

findings.summary: New learning files/directories relied on ambient umask (new directories reproduced as 0755).
findings.fix: New Unix directories 0700 and temporary/snapshot files 0600; no chmod of existing parents.

findings.summary: A preexisting fixed-name temporary symlink was followed and its target truncated.
findings.fix: Random same-directory temporary name with exclusive creation; preexisting temporary paths untouched.

findings.summary: Final rename failures left a temporary snapshot containing source/feedback.
findings.fix: Scope-based cleanup of this commit's temporary path; preserve old published data and retry semantics.

before_fix.command: env -u DATABASE_URL -u CYANREX_TEST_DATABASE_URL cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --locked --test module_boundaries_tdd learning_ -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
before_fix.note: Four corrupt-read route cases and three persistence cases failed on the old implementation. The recovery assertion was subsequently strengthened by seeding a teacher feedback revision.

new_tests.note: Seven initial red regressions, two closed-pool fault injections, one legitimate empty-state test, and one OpenAPI error-contract test. These are included in totals below, not additive to them.

checks.scope: File lengths, version/course/OpenAPI/SDK drift and compatibility, 63 common Node tests, fixture-based Agent/distribution/kernel-smoke/candidate-tool checks and Rust formatting. Not frontend/SDK runtime builds or live kernel acceptance.

checks.note: Benchmark caller compatibility checked; no benchmark executed.
The baseline source manifest and its earlier verification are intentionally retained, not automatically rehashed. API/access/page/catalog inventories are unchanged.

environment.database: DATABASE_URL and CYANREX_TEST_DATABASE_URL unset for portable tests. Closed lazy pools were closed before any query/connection.
environment.data: New synthetic temporary fixtures only, cleaned by fixture-owned guards; no deployed data migrated or modified.

not_run: One live Runner Agent/Clang HTTP acceptance
Real teacher/student LAN and SSH deployment
Fresh benchmarks and dependency security audits
remaining_limits: Existing run-record write fallback is unchanged, including previously latched/configured local mode.
Existing parent-directory permissions are not migrated; data paths require trusted ownership.
No fsync, crash recovery, cross-process locking or hostile-parent replacement protection.
Process kill/power loss/cleanup errors can leave temporary files; loading ignores them.
Loaded local snapshots do not watch external edits.

suggested_next.scope: Compiler checks and Runner/Agent submission, polling, cancellation and result ownership; not newly accepted in this focused pass.
